object.attr: stakeholder: a CI result that disagrees with what the author saw can't be acted on. Proposed until the Validate action reads the working copy. Shared code meets it trivially, so the test cases' expected results are worked out without Mellon's code (review Q19, CF-C50).
object.description: Given the same working copy, Mellon shall report the same load error or validation error codes, each with the same object ID, for a document through the Validate action, the MCP server and mellon-check.
